title: Chapter 479 Old Zhao Has A Son
content:
Chapter 479 Old Zhao Has A Son

But the two of them are located in the northeast and northwest of the Wana Empire.

And the distance between them is tens of thousands of miles, so it is not realistic to attack at the same time.

And there are not so many kings who can fight with them at the same time.

There are hundreds of small empires, regions and cities between these tens of thousands of miles.

They must push forward all the way.

Because it is not realistic to transport tens of millions of troops over long distances, the transportation cost alone is an astronomical figure.

After repeated discussions, Wang Shuo decided to send Duan Wenxi to the Maka Empire to meet Emperor Ma Hao in person.

"Your Majesty, then I'll leave!" Duan Wenxi was a little nervous. This was his first time to travel tens of thousands of miles to another country.

For his safety, Wang Shuo specially arranged for Sauron and Fang Daguang, the two strongest kings, to protect him.

On Ayub's side, he was constantly dispatching troops and preparing for the expedition.

One day, Wang Shuo heard that Ban Caiyi gave birth to a big fat boy for Zhao Bangde.

Wang Shuo was delighted and hurried to the residence of the national teacher.

Zhao Bangde, holding his son, went to the gate to greet Wang Shuo.

"Your Majesty..."

Wang Shuo looked at the smile on Zhao Bangde's face and was happy for him from the bottom of his heart.

"Old Zhao, congratulations on your son!"

Zhao Bangde also said with some pride: "Thanks to your majesty's blessing, my old Zhao family can be regarded as a successor."

"I wonder when your majesty plans to get married?"

Wang Shuo's mind appeared Ye Xueer's voice and smile, and he laughed: "Wait until the unification of the Shenwu Empire, what do you think?"

"Of course it's great, then it will be a double happiness."

Wang Shuo and Zhao Bangde came to the pavilion in the back garden.

It's been a long time since the two of them sat down leisurely and had a good chat.

After chatting with Zhao Bangde for a while, the two reviewed the bits and pieces they encountered along the way, and couldn't help but sigh.

A few days later, Wang Shuo reviewed the army of the Wana Empire again, and this time the army was more prosperous.

After the military parade, Wang Shuo asked Ayub to lead the army to the border of the Truni Empire.

This move made Queen Anna somewhat uneasy.

Over the past thousand years, the Truni Empire had also been glorious and had developed to the level of a second-level empire.

But she was unlucky. At that time, the Shenwu Empire was in its heyday and she had no chance to be promoted. After several suppressions, she became weak.

As the saying goes, a country has its own destiny. If an empire wants to grow and develop, it really needs an opportunity.

Queen Anna thought that this was an opportunity for the Truni Empire to rise again.

But she didn't expect that the Vana Empire would come out halfway, which was almost like killing her.

She sent people to beg Wang Shuo for help while asking for help from the Parthian Empire and the Badandiya Empire.

Wang Shuo is very relaxed now. The Truni Empire has no power to fight back in front of the Vana Empire. The number of the strongest kings is several times that of it.

And the number of soldiers is not at the same level at all.

Facing the envoy of the Truni Empire, Wang Shuo killed him directly.

Want to make peace?

No way.

This time, Wang Shuo also wanted to avenge the Frost Empire.

Moreover, a country that is half undead has no need to exist.

A month later, Duan Wenxi came back and brought news of the alliance.

Wang Shuo was reassured.

It’s not that this ally is so important.

But it can contain the two first-level empires in the east and the west.
